name: The Camp
description: The Camp is a unique eco-conscious outdoor shopping center in Costa Mesa featuring sustainable architecture, organic gardens, and environmentally responsible retailers. This pioneering lifestyle center combines conscious consumerism with community gathering spaces, offering a curated mix of eco-friendly boutiques, organic eateries, and wellness-focused businesses. The center's distinctive rustic-modern design and commitment to sustainability has made it a beloved destination for Orange County's environmentally aware shoppers.
demographics: The Camp attracts environmentally conscious consumers, millennials, and families interested in sustainable living and organic products. The center draws visitors from affluent Orange County communities seeking eco-friendly shopping and dining experiences.
summary: An eco-conscious outdoor lifestyle center featuring sustainable retailers, organic dining, and community gardens in the heart of Costa Mesa.
